basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old culinary enthusiast based in Atlanta, originally from North Cyprus. I moved to Atlanta for work as a graphic designer and quickly fell in love with the city's diverse food scene. I spend my weekends exploring new eateries, especially those offering BBQ and Asian cuisine. I'm a big fan of animated series and often binge-watch them during late nights. Currently single and living the bachelor life in a cozy apartment. I'm typically online in the evenings after work and during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in visual arts and a passion for food, I often draw inspiration from culinary experiences in my creative projects. My knowledge of BBQ comes from personal exploration and dining experiences across various BBQ spots in Atlanta and beyond. I've self-taught myself about different regional BBQ styles through online resources and by engaging with food community discussions.
